newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH OCT WHOLESALES, RETAIL SALES SURGE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH OCT WHOLESALES, RETAIL SALES SURGE.

text.p: The volume of Finnish wholesales rose 8.4 percent year-on-year in October and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 11.6 percent, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday in a statement.
The volume of retail sales rose 9.8 percent and the value excluding VAT of those sales rose 10.3 percent, SF said.
"All wholesale sectors, except for fuel wholesales, increased their volumes on October of last year," SF said.
Automobile wholesales rose almost 15 percent year-on-year. In retail trade, October car sales were a quarter higher than in the same period last year, SF said.
January-October wholesales were up 2.3 percent and retail sales up 4.0 percent year-on-year, SF said.
